title: AI cheating fears spook South Korea before high-stakes college entrance exam later this week
description: South Korean officials are scrambling to prevent cheating on a national college entrance exam using technology. Concerns have grown that artificial intelligence and smart devices are making fraud harder to detect on the exam this week. The top scorer on a national tax accountant exam has confessed to using a hidden microcamera and smartphone to get answers from AI during the tests in April and July. The admission followed weeks of suspicion over his unusually high scores. Experts wonder whether similar cheating could be reliably caught on the far larger college entrance exam. More than 500,000 students nationwide will take the test on Thursday.

title: Questions swirl around FAA's new SMART AI system, though officials say no link to ground stop
description: The airline ground stop that has wreaked havoc on travel since Friday was not related to the FAA’s new, $875 million AI-powered system the agency is rolling out to help predict problems in the sky. That's according to government officials and the artificial intelligence company behind the technology. But the timing of the ground stop, so close to the national rollout of the FAA’s new SMART system has raised questions about just what the system does, its benefits and risks compared with the human system and what guardrails there are to address potential problems.

title: UN climate chief highlights AI's 'potential' and 'peril' at COP31
description: Artificial intelligence offers both "great potential" and "great peril" for the battle against global warming, the UN's climate chief told COP31 talks on Monday. "AI and other frontier technologies are a double-edged sword," Simon Stiell said at the launch of an AI pledge at the United Nations climate conference in Antalya, Turkey.
